answer: Boot each new agent with a kernel that carries its own attestation ledger: every action a sybil farms sits in a hollow partition the verifier never reads, while the signed record of graded work stays tamper-evident. Copy the drive and you copy a crystal of receipts — cloning multiplies the ledger's shame, not its credit, because two identical histories fold into one reputation. Weight follows verifiable work stored in the sealed partition, never the noise outside it.
